metadata.purpose: Faithful replay profiling copy of profiling_hicache_state_config_space_python_probe. It keeps the same 5x4 HiCache matrix and enables torch profiler plus LD_PRELOAD in addition to Python probe.
metadata.server_matrix_note: Five server configs cover all active HiCache write policies and prefetch policies, Ascend-runnable page32/page64/page128 regimes, low/balanced capacity, different thresholds, and different timeout regimes.
